description: Calculates the great-circle distance between two geographic points using the Haversine formula. Returns distance in kilometers, miles, or nautical miles. (cost: 1 credit)

lat1.description: number, required, latitude of first point, decimal degrees, no default

lat2.description: number, required, latitude of second point, decimal degrees, no default

lon1.description: number, required, longitude of first point, decimal degrees, no default

lon2.description: number, required, longitude of second point, decimal degrees, no default

unit.description: string, optional, unit of measurement (km/miles/nautical), no unit, default km

name: calculate_distance
